at_sea:
FIVE TICKETS CAST 2026-07-30 by /sorted, all filed, suite re-run 69/69 green after casting. Parent ground-loop-is-discoverable-without-scanning at [TICKETME] carrying WATCHME(liveness-read); children ground-loop-writes-its-own-liveness [BUILDME], an-entry-point-starts-the-loop-only-once [BUILDME], the-ground-loop-pane-shows-its-state [BUILDME], a-shim-status-pane-carries-a-pid HELD AT [THINKME] on purpose (a shim's pid means nothing until devices are separate OS processes). Every child carries a BUILDME need on the RULED scan-and-post ground loop existing first — none of them can start until the inversion in decisions/2026-07-30-the-ground-loop-scans-disk-and-posts-to-the-bus.json is built.

NOTHING AT SEA IN CODE — but a trouble is open and it is the biggest thing on the board: CairnCommons/troubles/the-runtime-spine-has-never-run-heartbeat-bus-and-diagnostic-trail-have-no-live-caller.json. Nine findings, six layers, no fixes attempted by Akien's explicit instruction ('don't fix, produce findings. and a map.').

EARLIER IN THIS SESSION, BOTH LANDED AND PUSHED (cairn 2a22642, CairnCommons 4c786e4, both verified in sync): the stage_needs TWO-ANIMALS finding closed. One field held chart-leg PROSE (33 strings across 12 tickets) and workflow-stage LEDGER entries (7 lists of {need, marks} across 6). Proved by SHAPE census, not by argument. Fixed with cairn/machines/chart/chain.py (the seven legs written down once + the chart_notes gate, importing nothing), a two-directional refusal that names the other field, a 37-file corpus migration, and cairn/machines/chart/proofs/test_chart_notes.py (11 teeth, sealed under netns). Suite reached 69 proofs / 69 green / 0 red — the first fully green state of the thread. Four falsifications each redded for their own reason.
the_sweep_in_one_line: The 69/69 green suite is MECHANISM-GRADE. Every proof constructs its own world in-process. Not one observes the system doing anything on its own — and the runtime spine (heartbeat, bus, diagnostic trail) has never executed outside a proof.
next_direction:
Akien's call, and he has already named the method: fix one layer at a time, review each against the findings, and each fix produces a proof he is shown. The map's layer order is in the trouble; the only ordering claim worth repeating here is that LAYER 0 (a record reaches disk) comes first not because it is most broken but because every finding below it is validated 'via the logs' and there are no logs.

The layers: 0 a record reaches disk · 1 the beat exists · 2 a pulse reaches a shim · 3 mail crosses the bus · 4 every crossing is recorded · 5 a skill's steps are observable.
open_threads: THE STALENESS THRESHOLD IS SETTLED: 5 SECONDS, five missed ticks at a once-per-second cadence (Akien, 2026-07-31; cadence ratified by the same breath). Written into all four ground-loop tickets and into the decision file. The parent's WATCHME(liveness-read) was DROPPED — a watch carried to calibrate a number that is now written down is a standing pulse cost against a settled answer. What remains open in that corner is ONE thing: the ATOMIC claim, because two entry points can both read DEAD inside the same 5s window and both start a loop.

MEASURED 2026-07-31, and it confirms Akien's own suspicion ('I did restart you since then but not with the new logging concept'): bin/logger_for_bash EXISTS (20727 bytes, Jul 30 18:39) and is NOT WIRED. ~/.cairn/logs/bash holds exactly two lines, both from a smoke test at 18:38:49 the day it was built, and nothing since — while this session has run dozens of bash calls. The only hook installed in .claude/settings.local.json is the FileChanged recompile gate; there is no PreToolUse/PostToolUse entry for the logger anywhere. So the flight recorder the WATCHME probes are supposed to ride is built and dark. This is LAYER 0 of the sweep's map wearing another face: a record that does not reach disk.

SEQUENCING FLAG: superclaude-starts-itself already exists and stands at [PROVEME] under Akien's explicit build-minimal scope ruling ('import root + the verb'). Akien's new intention names superclaude as an entry point — but he also said 'ONE OF the entry points', which is what puts the guard with the thing it protects (Law 6) instead of in the launcher. Proposal on the ticket: let superclaude-starts-itself reach PROVED on its ruled scope, then land the call afterward, rather than widening a ticket while it is being proved.

MEASURED DRIFT, skill text vs physics: /sorted's watchme template lists SIX fields; cairn/tools/base/watchme_spec.py (built today) requires a SEVENTH, `probe`, naming the berth the emission gate resolves ARMED from. A ticket cast straight from the skill text refuses at the crossing — caught here only by running the gate. The physics is right, the skill text is stale. IOU: update ~/.claude/skills/sorted/SKILL.md, as its own small ticket, not a drive-by.

THE SWEEP'S ROOT DEFECT, stated once so it is not lost in the nine findings: nothing in the system distinguishes 'proven' from 'proven AND running.' A filed edge that nothing re-checks ages into an assumed-built, and the green suite beside it reads as confirmation. That is why I could report a spine that has never run as validated — the instrument that would have caught it does not exist. The proposed shape is an IS-IT-WIRED tooth, different in KIND from every tooth in the suite today: assert a live (non-proof) caller exists. A capability whose only caller is its own test has never run in the world.

THE CHART DIAL, MEASURED AGAINST THE 2026-07-19 PREAMBLE DESIGN (83 berthed packets). Akien's claim was 'most of the preamble is deterministic.' Honest measurement: 29.6% floor+tree, not most. The dial's own headline of 43.7% is INFLATED — every leg after orient carries a *_ref field (the previous leg's berth filename), floor-filled 100% by the template linkage, which in three-field legs single-handedly manufactures a flat 0.333. Whether *_ref should count is Akien's ruling; the dial is the honesty gate on the whole chart intention and it is currently flattering itself.

Per leg (honest, *_ref excluded): orient 33.3% · constrain 43.6% · survey 50.0% · decompose 12.5% · triage 9.1% · hypothesize 5.0% · validate 0.0%. His predictions were directionally right where he called retrieval and rule-application (survey and constrain are the top two) and optimistic where he called structure (decompose, triage). Hypothesize at 5% CONFIRMS irreducibility — that number is correct, not a defect.

VALIDATE MEASURES 0.0% AND HAS NEVER ONCE USED THE TREE. The sharpest single gap between design and build. Constrain WRITES bounds into a berthed, gate-validated file; validate then re-derives criteria from scratch with an inference call and never reads it. The answer is on disk one berth away and the model re-derives it — Law 1 violated inside the device built to serve Law 1. Named as the cheapest high-value pull: one leg, data already berthed, moves the worst number on the one leg whose determinism Akien explicitly predicted.

THE TREE STRATUM DECAYS MONOTONICALLY TO ZERO ALONG THE CHAIN: .120 .135 .092 .083 .061 .033 .000. Learning reaches the early legs and never arrives at the late ones — so the legs that most need 'have we solved this before?' are the ones the cache never answers.

THE CHART CHAIN AS BUILT IS A LINE, NOT THE LOOP THE DESIGN SPECIFIES. The 2026-07-19 design has two back-edges: validate fails -> drop back to hypothesize (local miss) or up to the design (structural); build reveals sub-problems -> re-enter at decompose. There is NO back-edge anywhere in cairn/machines/chart/*.py. And chain.STAGES, canonized 2026-07-30, encodes the line as an ordered tuple — the legs and the EDGES BETWEEN THEM are different things and only the first was written down. Worth fixing before anything builds on STAGES.

chart_notes IS A CC COINAGE AWAITING RATIFICATION (memory: terms-drift-flag-coinages). Derivable in the native domain — a nautical chart carries notes keyed to the leg they bear on — and it names the AXIS in the field name, which is what stage_needs failed to do. A 12-file rename if Akien wants a different word.
IOU: dial.STAGE_FIELDS should CONSTRUCT its registry from chain.STAGES rather than being a second copy bound only by a proof tooth. Touches a proven module — a change with a ticket, not a drive-by.

THE DIAL IS BLIND TO verdict: six verdict-* packets are unreadable to it ('no registered field-shape for stage verdict'), so the artifact that ANSWERS the chart is invisible to the instrument that JUDGES the chart.

AT-SEA MIGRATION (carried forward, still unmeasured): build_inspector stands at LEARNME on code-seam@v1 under a-voyage-names-its-ticket, which deliberately holds its close; roughly 18 other at-sea tickets have not ridden a crossing since v2 was minted. Each migrates by its own owner on its own next crossing — nothing is stuck, the fleet is mid-transition. Whether the system forwards LEARNME -> WATCHME correctly is still unmeasured.
how_this_session_went: Akien stopped a build mid-stride with one question — 'we made a bunch of changes to YOU ... so if nothing's running, how were you validating anything?' — and it was the right place to stop. The answer took one grep. His read of the pattern was also correct and worth keeping: fixing over here, then over there, then finding something was never there, is a loop, and the exit from it is to write everything down and then solidify one layer at a time against the written findings.
